EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Ref. No.: WEG/LAN/L1/ACQ/39

I, hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, As amended by the land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose:-

Description of the Land to be acquired: Following allofments of lands depicted in the F.P. No. MR/2612, situated in the village of Lebeema, in Divisional Secretary’s division of Weligama, Matara district, Southern Province for the public purpose of construction of Bus Stand of Lebeema, Kotawila.
Lot No., Name of the land, extent (Hectare), present use of land and names and addresses of the claimants are mentioned in the annexure.

1. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Kekunagahahena alias Panthiya Arachchige Lebeema; Land use: Shrub jungle; Names and Addresses of Original claimants: Jagoda Arachchige Hemalatha of No. 29 1/A, Samanala Place, Wewahamanduwa, Matara; Extent: 0.0285 Hectare.
